text.offer: Deeper in the valley, in the bone-dry wasteland, the minotaurs rule. They are the reason no Berg caravan goes south. Kill eight of them - and take your strongest friends.
text.progress: The minotaurs roam the Valley of Death, the bone-dry wasteland and the parched stretches beyond.
text.complete: Eight minotaurs. The bards of Berg will sing of you.
